panels.description: Entry Limit Probability is the maximum price allowed by the frozen entry decision. Re-entry is allowed at most once after a full first exit and a later V2 re-arm proof. Exit eligibility requires full visible depth whose net proceeds after fees meet Required Net Exit Proceeds. Hypothetical Resting Exit Limit Probability is an accounting reference only: no resting order is placed and it is never fill evidence.

targets.queryText: SELECT event_utc AS 'UTC', position_id AS 'Position', event_type AS 'Record', COALESCE(action, '') AS 'Action', COALESCE(json_extract(payload_json, '$.entry_number'), json_extract(payload_json, '$.reentry_number')) AS 'Entry Number', COALESCE(json_extract(payload_json, '$.rearm_reason'), '') AS 'Re-arm Reason', COALESCE(side, '') AS 'Side', COALESCE(json_extract(payload_json, '$.observed_best_ask_probability'), json_extract(payload_json, '$.observed_best_bid_probability')) AS 'Observed Market Probability', json_extract(payload_json, '$.simulated_price') AS 'Simulated Fill Probability', json_extract(payload_json, '$.decision_limit_price') AS 'Entry Limit Probability', json_extract(payload_json, '$.hypothetical_resting_exit_limit_probability') AS 'Hypothetical Resting Exit Limit Probability (Not Placed)', json_extract(payload_json, '$.required_total_net_proceeds') AS 'Required Net Exit Proceeds', json_extract(payload_json, '$.visible_full_exit_net_proceeds') AS 'Visible Net Exit Proceeds', net_edge_per_contract AS 'Net Edge / Contract', COALESCE(reason, '') AS 'Reason' FROM shadow_events WHERE scenario_id = ${scenario_id:sqlstring} AND event_type IN ('shadow_decision', 'shadow_no_fill', 'shadow_simulated_fill') AND (run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} OR ${run_id:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${run_id:sqlstring} = '__current__' AND run_id = (SELECT value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key='input_run_id'))) ORDER BY event_utc DESC, event_sequence DESC LIMIT 200
